messages:
maria-cs: Heads up - Zeta Health (pilot) asked for a short, regional routing + throughput bump for an APAC demo next Tue. They want traffic to prefer SG and a temporary QPS increase.

maria-cs: Details from customer: sustain ~200 QPS, 72h window, start 2026-04-05T08:00:00Z. Add IP ranges for peering: 52.23.12.0/24, 18.204.0.0/16. Also requested logs retained 30d for audit.

anya-ops: Got it. Do they need an allowlist or just a routing override?

maria-cs: Both. Allowlist + routing preference. They asked we pin to sg-edge cluster and avoid fallback to US unless absolutely necessary. Also flagged as a renewal signal after pilot.

derek-infra: I can add a temporary routing policy and ACL. Quick question: 200 QPS on shared pool might bump into burst controls. If so, we'll add a provisional capacity tag.

maria-cs: They are CS pilot tier (no Dedicated). Theyprefer no 503s during the demo but can tolerate short backoff if unavoidable.

paul-rls: @derek-infra please add a provisional capacity reservation on sg-edge for 72h and schedule auto-revoke. Tagging for capacity planning and renewals.

derek-infra: Will do. Plan to push a provisional override JSON to config: ```json
{
  "customer": "zeta-health",
  "window_start": "2026-04-05T08:00:00Z",
  "duration": "72h",
  "region_preference": "ap-southeast-1",
  "qps_override": 200,
  "ip_allowlist": ["52.23.12.0/24","18.204.0.0/16"],
  "auto_revoke": true
}
```

sam-support: Quick compliance check: 30d logs retention for a health customer - do we need extra approvals for PHI? Security usually ok for pilot but if payloads may contain PHI we need DSR/PII handling. Maria, did they confirm data is de-identified?

maria-cs: They said demo will use de-identified data. I'll attach the signed DPA to the ticket.

paul-rls: Adding renewal note: if pilot shows p95 latency < 200ms and low error rate, we should push for Dedicated conversion in ~60d. Also collect feedback during enablement.

derek-infra: Pushed provisional config to staging, running smoke tests. If green, will promote with auto-revoke schedule.

deploy-bot: deploy 2551 -> sg-routing-provisional applied to staging (smoke_ok).

anya-ops: Routing policy created: `route_policy: sg_prefer_fallback=false` and IP ACL added. Auto-revoke scheduled at 2026-04-08T08:01:00Z.

sam-support: Created CS ticket CS-8342 for audit trail, will attach DPA and set 7-day follow-up to collect qualitative feedback.

maria-cs: I'll run a short enablement call with Zeta on Mon 2026-04-04 to walk through failover behavior and expectations. Will capture renewal sentiment during call. :thumbsup:

paul-rls: Post-demo eval items: p95 latency, error rate, and cost per 1k tokens. Add notes to playbook.

maria-cs: Dropping demo notes into CS-8342 and will ping product if we see any edge regressions.

derek-infra: Change log: provisional qps bump + ip allowlist applied (auto-revoke). Monitoring set for rate and latency; keeping eyes on dashboards.

deploy-bot: monitor alert: no elevated error rates in first 10m after apply.

maria-cs: Great work, thanks everyone.
